methods.cell_completed: Exclude only failed generations; cell populations differ.
methods.matched_panel: Exclude all eight conditions of a model/item/run if any failed.
methods.complete_item: Exclude an original item from all conditions/runs if any failed.

bootstrap.unit: Crossed original-item/run labels; shared draws across conditions; percentile 95% CIs, unadjusted.
bootstrap.complete_item: Resample the model-specific retained items at their retained sample size; all five run labels retained.

warning: All exclusions condition on post-treatment completion. Cell-only exclusion changes comparison populations. Matched exclusions remove healthy counterparts too. None replaces the registered failure-inclusive estimand.
